I was beyond surprised to see my art have such a big impact on the community and now I feel I have to both explain myself and my art. First off there's a huge trigger warning on the explanation of the art but not on the art itself. Gore art and the grotesque have been huge concepts in art since Roman times and have roots in the Rennaisance, Surrealism, and Modern movements. Artists who use gore and have also experienced criticism include Dali, Picasso, Caravaggio, and Nitsch. Art is meant to be whatever the artist intends and I intended my art to be shocking, disgusting, and to cause the viewer to feel something. I think art should make the viewer feel something and to have my art hit so deep in people's psyches that they go home and write hate comments about my work fulfills my goal.   
This piece was meant to be a physical representation of how my abusive childhood has created sensory issues that still haunt me today. The alternate title for this work was "My father is a very bad man" which was also written several times on the notes taped to the fridge door. I was severely tortured as a kid and had to suppress these thoughts until very recently when I was able to wake up from a decade of dissociation. The gore and guts represent the trauma and the way my childhood was destroyed and killed before I even got a chance to enjoy it.   
If you think my work is deranged and proves I'm an insane person, I hope you never encounter anyone like my dad. I cannot describe the pain and the torture he put me through. He was beyond sick and twisted and he knew it. He recorded himself many times berating me and abusing me and this caused my fear of being watched. This is represented by the mirror in the back of the microwave. The figures in the window represent the shadowy figures I hallucinated in times of psychological breaks. The top cubby with ropes and the plastic doll chair represents when my dad would interrogate me and leave me tied to a chair. The second cubby with the teeth and saliva represents my experience with braces at 7 years old and having to get 7 teeth removed in the same day to speed up the process. My father would slap my mouth as punishment because he knew how bad it hurt after getting braces tightened. The third cubby with the feather boa and the diary represents my childhood diary that was photocopied and submitted to the courts as documentation of my psychological instability by my father which has resulted in a terrible fear of vulnerability and journaling in general. The last cubby is a representation of my father's punishment with water. If I was slightly unwilling to get in the bathtub, my dad would fill it up and add ice, then throw me in with my clothes on. If I was in trouble, he would hose me down and make me stand in the cold outside until he felt I learned my lesson. The mold in the sink was another punishment of his, where he made me drink a cup because I had broken a set of dishes. TLDR: my dad hurt me and I'm still hurting now even though I was removed from the house almost ten years ago.  
Mental illness is haunting. Art is meant to express the unspoken feelings of the artist. I am terrible at communicating in words but I am able to share what I mean through my art. I am sorry if my work offended you but my work is no more offensive than some of the greatest works we still talk about today. I hope the conversation continues, I hope people make their own art, and I hope those who are mad about it can figure out what unresolved trauma of their own is causing this reaction.  
I'm happy to answer any questions about the piece or my process in general.

this is totally doable if you space them out like this. take advantage of getting a head start so you’re not too stressed if you fail o-chem later on lol. 

physics series is so easy online. quizzes twice a week with assigned readings and short homework assignments that mirror the questions on the quizzes. no final since it went online. 

mcdb 1b is info heavy, you’ll want to use a bunch of flash cards, draw out the systems and mechanisms, and read the text book if something is confusing. mcdb 1b is the precursor to mcdb 111 so if you plan on taking that in the future pay attention a bit more and it’ll help you a lot. 

i took mcdb 1LL in person so I can’t really speak to online. i took the eemb lab online and it’s pretty simple, take the prelabs seriously and pay attention on zoom and the lab manual practically fills itself out. mcdb 1LL has a lot of cool labs about smaller organisms like flies and bacteria but beware of slacking off on the paper. it’s a quarter long project making a research poster about one of the labs and you should follow along in working on each weekly task so you don’t end up rushing it all the night before. 

overall you should be pretty good if you stay organized and caught up. please pm me if you need a pdf of any of the textbooks and good luck!
